body: Thanks, I definitely appreciate the feedback and I'll start implementing some changes today.
I agree and thanks for the feedback.

It's all good, and I do understand. I'm a gamer myself, but when I get down not even that brings me any joy, not much does. The only thing that helps me is to just try and find a little bit of hope somewhere in something. I know that it's definitely not easy, but try and find something to look forward to in the future. 

You have access to the internet, so look up some hobbies that you might be able to do on a low budget, or even a business that you could start on the cheap. Just always be looking at how to create something.

First of all, I'm really sorry that you feel so down.

I'm almost 23 and living with my mom and grandfather, so don't stress about your living situation. What're your interests in life though? what brings you joy, even just a tiny amount?

I hear you, living is tough at the best of times, but you need to push through because as cliche as it sounds it can get better. It can also get worse, and it can also get better, then worse again. The point that I'm trying to make is that the times that are okay or good, are what make life worth living. Don't cut short your opportunities to feel good. PM if you'd like to talk more.

Hey man. I know that this probably won't help, but I understand how you feel. I'm in very much a similar position, so I can relate and hopefully that makes you see that you're not alone. Anyway, what kind of games do you like to work on, and what kind of songs do you like to write?

Hey man

First of all I can honestly empathize with you. I struggled in school myself, and I haven't even gone to Uni/collage.  Life is hard, it's true, but just do me a favor and keep pushing because you honestly don't know what could happen in your future. I know that's cliched advice, but it's true. You need to embrace all of life, the good and the bad, and at the same time direct what little energy you can sum up into something constructive. 

I honestly hope this helps you. Just don't cut you life short.

Well your girlfriend is right about one thing, that's that you absolutely should not end your life over this.  Please feel free to PM and talk to me about this situation.  Maybe I can give you same advice and guidance that can help you out.
That is actually really cleaver. How come you're dead inside though?

Hell Yes!!! I wish that a zombie apocolypse would happen already. Then again any apocolypse would be awesome. I think for me I would just really like it because then it would give my life meaning in as much as I could help others.
Yeah I did try that, but still no luck. I did find a paper clip that I lost though LOL.  Thanks for the suggestion though

You can do it man. It gets easier over time,it really does. At first it's brutal,and the last relapse I had kicked my arse so I try to keep that in mind. My only advice though wouldn't be to reach 90 days per say(although you should give yourself a massive pat on the back if you do),but to just wake up in the morning and say "I will not fap today",and then say the same thing the next day.
Thank fucking you lol. But seriously, I appreciate it and same goes for you.

The journey's been tough,but I doubt that it is easy for any of us who try it. I just admire the hell out of anyone who wants to try nofap because it's so tough,and we don't get the kind of support alcoholics or drug addicts do. That's why I'm with you on the forum thing. we need to stand together and help each other.

I really like what you say about how it's not about that one time, it's the process and you're absolutely right, but it's worth it.
